description_full: SMG Swiss Marketplace Group Holding AG operates as an online marketplace and digital company in Switzerland. It operates through three segments: Real Estate, Automotive, and General Marketplaces. The Real Estate segment provides digital platforms and services for renting, selling, and managing property. The Automotive segment operates digital marketplaces for new and used vehicles and motorbikes. The General Marketplaces segment operates digital marketplaces that facilitate transactions between buyers and sellers across a range of new and used goods and services. The company also offers platforms that allow users to compare and take out insurance for vehicles, household contents and healthcare, and consumer loans; and online advertising services for SME, agency, automotive, real estate, and companies. SMG Swiss Marketplace Group Holding AG was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

financial_summary: SMG SWISS MARKETPLACE GROUP AG is a mid-cap communication services business with a $3.7B market cap on $396M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +18% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +4.2pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 7% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 108% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $127M in free cash flow — roughly 32 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.08× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 24× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 2.0%, a thin return of capital.
